name: Now Playing
description: Spotify or Apple Music in Orca's sidebar: Home, your library, search, queue and devices for Spotify, the Music app's player for Apple Music, plus a now-playing status bar item. Your coding agents can play, pause, search and queue too. Works with the Spotify or Music app on a Mac out of the box. Not affiliated with Spotify or Apple.

cover.alt: Now Playing in Orca's sidebar: Your Library with Liked Songs and playlists, the player with its device menu, and an agent playing music from a terminal

screenshots.alt: The panel in dark theme: Home with recently played albums and playlists, Your Library, and an album page
screenshots.caption: Home, Your Library and every album, artist and playlist

screenshots.alt: A coding agent in an Orca terminal runs now-playing to search and play an album, and the panel updates
screenshots.caption: Your agents can drive it too

screenshots.alt: The desktop-app player in Orca's light theme next to the device picker of a connected Spotify account
screenshots.caption: No setup on a Mac, or any device with your account

settings.title: Music service
settings.description: Which app Now Playing shows and controls. Apple Music works through the Music app on macOS. The switch at the bottom of the panel changes this too.

settings.title: Spotify backend
settings.description: How Now Playing reaches Spotify. Auto uses the desktop app on macOS and the Spotify Web API elsewhere. Kept while Apple Music is selected, so switching back returns to it.

settings.title: Spotify Client ID
settings.description: From the app you created at developer.spotify.com/dashboard. Needed for the Web API.

settings.title: Redirect port
settings.description: Port of the login redirect, http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback. Change it only if 43117 is taken, and add the new address to your Spotify app.

settings.title: Agent access
settings.description: Let coding agents and scripts on this computer control Spotify with the now-playing command (~/.orca-now-playing/now-playing). Only this computer can reach it, with a token only you can read.

settings.title: Agent skill
settings.description: Teach Claude Code, Codex and other agents to use it: installs a now-playing skill in ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills. Turning this off removes it.
